'''Grappling turret''' was a weapon installed aboard [[YV-865 Aurore-class freighter/Legends|YV-865 ''Aurore''-class freighters]] used by the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]]. The Zygerrians used grapple turrets to engtangle their victims and reel them inside of the freighter.
